questions.question: The Asian Football Confederation postponed the 2027 AFC Asian Cup by a full year due to regional security concerns in which host country?
questions.explanation: The tournament originally set for January 2027 in Saudi Arabia was pushed back to 2028 because of travel disruptions and security threats.
questions.context: 2027 AFC Asian Cup, Houthi–Saudi conflict: In association football, the Asian Football Confederation postpones the 2027 Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia from January 2027 to January 2028, citing security concerns and travel disruptions following Houthi attacks on the country.

questions.question: A newly launched online database in Hungary has made public thousands of records connected to which former institution?
questions.explanation: Prime Minister Péter Magyar opened access to a database listing roughly 60,000 names linked to Hungary's former state security services.
questions.context: Hungary makes Communist-era secret police records publicly accessible through a database containing approximately 60,000 names linked to former state security services. Prime Minister Péter Magyar announces that additional documents will become available in February 2027.

questions.question: Protests by garment workers in Bangladesh recently prompted the country's wage board to take which action?
questions.explanation: Following five days of demonstrations and clashes with local authorities, the Bangladeshi garment industry wage board agreed to boost minimum pay rates.
questions.context: The Bangladeshi garment industry wage board agrees to increase minimum wages following five days of worker protests and clashes with police. Workers demand ৳30,000 (US$240) monthly, up from ৳12,500 (US$100), while the board has not specified the increase.

questions.question: Singapore's parliament updated its haze pollution laws to dramatically increase maximum financial penalties to S$20 million following smoke pollution caused by wildfires in which nation?
questions.explanation: Singapore boosted legal penalties and enforcement powers in response to widespread transboundary air pollution originating from Indonesian forest fires.
questions.context: 2026 Southeast Asian haze: The Singaporean parliament amends the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act of 2014, introducing arrest powers, permitting trials without defendants present, and increasing maximum fines tenfold to S$20 million (US$15 million) following widespread air pollution from Indonesian wildfires.

questions.question: Which space telescope recently completed a 22-year mission observing gamma-ray bursts when it re-entered Earth's atmosphere over Sumatra?
questions.explanation: The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory burned up over Sumatra, concluding over two decades of space exploration.
questions.context: The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory, a space telescope for studying gamma-ray bursts, re-enters Earth's atmosphere over Sumatra, ending its mission of nearly 22 years.
